siteAboutFirst: Kongye is a technology company based in Beijing, China. Our current product focus is developing the WorldsWithin iOS app, connecting mobile devices, spatial capture, and 3D content.
siteAboutSecond: We want capturing and experiencing digital spaces to become part of everyday life. Starting with familiar places, we explore more natural ways to express content. This website provides official company information and contact details.

legalPrivacyS0P0: “方寸间” (the “Product”) is operated by 【公司名称待注册后填写】 (“we” or “us”). This Policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your personal information, and your rights and how to exercise them. Please read this Policy carefully before using the Product, especially the terms in bold.
legalPrivacyS0P1: Five key points first; details follow in the text:
legalPrivacyS0P2: ① The original photos you capture are processed only on your phone and are never uploaded. Only the reconstructed 3D point clouds and thumbnails rendered from them are uploaded;
legalPrivacyS0P3: ② The Product embeds no third-party analytics, advertising, push notification or crash collection components and contains no form of user tracking;
legalPrivacyS0P4: ③ We do not share your personal information with any third party;
legalPrivacyS0P5: ④ Deleting your account deletes your personal information (except information retained as required by law; see Chapter IV);
legalPrivacyS0P6: ⑤ Under national rules on internet user account information, we publicly display your account's IP region (at provincial level). This display cannot be disabled.
legalPrivacyS0P7: If you disagree with this Policy, please do not register for or use the Product. Your disagreement does not exempt processing required by laws and regulations (such as displaying the IP region).
legalPrivacyS1Title: I. What personal information we collect and why
legalPrivacyS1P0: We collect personal information only in the following five scenarios. Each item states its purpose, method and retention period. Except for your phone number, all items are optional; refusing to provide them does not affect your use of other functions.
legalPrivacyS1P2: · Mobile phone number (provided when you choose the phone method): Used for phone registration, sign-in, verification codes and account recovery. You do not also need to provide a phone number when using email. Verification SMS messages are sent by the service provider described in Chapter III. Retained until account deletion.
legalPrivacyS1P3: · Email address (provided when you choose the email method): Used for email registration, sign-in, verification codes, account recovery and important notices. You do not also need to provide an email address when using the phone method. Retained until unlinked or the account is deleted.
legalPrivacyS1P4: · Sign-in password [sensitive information]: Stored only as a one-way hash; we cannot view your plain-text password. Transmission is encrypted throughout. Passwords are sensitive personal information; please do not reuse a password from another platform.
legalPrivacyS1P5: · Nickname, account ID and biography [optional]: Used to show your identity in the community. Nicknames may be duplicated; account IDs are unique across the platform. All three are displayed publicly. Retained until you change them or delete your account.
legalPrivacyS1P6: (2) Capture and 3D reconstruction — completed entirely on your phone
legalPrivacyS1P7: · Camera images and motion sensor data: Used only for on-device capture guidance and 3D reconstruction; not uploaded or stored on servers.
legalPrivacyS1P8: · Original photos: Saved in the Product's documents directory on your device. You can view, export or delete them using the system Files app. We do not collect original photos; they do not leave your device in any form.
legalPrivacyS1P9: · Reconstructed 3D point clouds: Stored only on your device until you choose to publish them.
legalPrivacyS1P11: · Work content [optional; necessary for publishing]: When you publish a work, we collect its 3D point cloud model file, thumbnail (rendered from the point cloud, not a camera photo), title and description. After approval, the work is displayed publicly to all users, including visitors who are not signed in.
legalPrivacyS1P12: · When publishing, you acknowledge that once the work is published and approved, its content, your nickname, account ID and IP region at publication will be visible to everyone.
legalPrivacyS1P13: · IP region: Under Article 12 of the Provisions on the Administration of Internet User Account Information, work information displays your IP region at publication, and your account information page displays your IP region from your most recent use. Within China, this is shown at province level (including autonomous regions and municipalities); outside China, at country or region level. No more precise location is displayed. The system determines the region automatically from the IP address; neither you nor we can change it manually. You may appeal through the contact methods in Chapter IX.
legalPrivacyS1P14: · Research and technical improvement: The work content you upload will be used for our internal scientific research, technology development and improvement, including but not limited to training, evaluating and optimizing various AI algorithms and models (such as those related to 3D reconstruction). When providing research data externally, we use only anonymized data that cannot identify you and cannot be restored, or obtain your separate consent. See Chapter VI of the 方寸间 User Agreement.
legalPrivacyS1P15: · Like, report and block records: Used to provide the corresponding functions and govern the community. Likes on public works are visible to other users; reports are visible only to you and platform administrators. Retained until you undo the action, the relevant work is deleted or your account is deleted.
legalPrivacyS1P16: · View records: Used only to show view counts to work authors, deduplicated hourly; not used for any personalized recommendations or advertising. Retained until the relevant work is deleted; anonymized and no longer linked to you after account deletion.
legalPrivacyS1P18: · IP address and device identification string (User-Agent): Recorded in security audit logs during key actions such as registration, sign-in, publishing, deletion and reporting, for security, abuse prevention and lawful regulatory cooperation. IP addresses also generate the provincial IP region display described above. Both purposes are disclosed here; we do not use them for other purposes. General audit records are retained for 180 days; records concerning account deletion and content enforcement for 730 days; the system then deletes them automatically.
legalPrivacyS1P19: · API frequency records: Brief records of API call frequency are kept to prevent abuse, for no more than 1 day.
legalPrivacyS1P21: · Usage events: To understand how the Product is used and detect and fix failures, we collect feature usage events (such as the start, success or failure of publishing and the failure stage), session identifiers, error and crash summaries (error messages and truncated code stacks, excluding your work content or profile), system version and app version. Analytics is built by us; data goes only to our own servers, without any third-party analytics component. Retained for 180 days and then automatically deleted; detached from your identity (anonymized) after account deletion.
legalPrivacyS1P22: · Analytics is nonessential information: You can disable it at any time in “Settings → Help improve the product”. We then stop collection and clear analytics data on your device that has not yet been reported. No function is affected.
legalPrivacyS1P23: (6) Under laws and regulations, your consent is not required for processing necessary to perform statutory duties or obligations; respond to public health emergencies or protect natural persons' life, health or property in emergencies; process, within a reasonable scope, personal information you have made public or that has otherwise been lawfully made public; or other circumstances provided by laws and administrative regulations.
legalPrivacyS2Title: II. Device permissions and local storage
legalPrivacyS2P0: The Product requests system permissions or opens system pickers as needed for the following functions, when you first use the corresponding function, never at launch.
legalPrivacyS2P1: · Camera: To capture photos for on-device 3D reconstruction and recognize QR codes when you choose QR sign-in. Refusing permission prevents the corresponding camera functions but does not affect other functions such as community browsing.
legalPrivacyS2P2: · Motion & Fitness (motion sensors): For real-time capture guidance and camera pose estimation. Data is processed only on your device. Refusing permission affects capture guidance accuracy.

legalPrivacyS2P4: Local storage: The Product has no embedded web browser and does not use cookies.
